service.description: MCP Tool: Scaffolds a new XML screen file on disk under the target component, auto-registers the artifact in AgiArtifact, seeds the WorkspaceBuffer AST, and links it to a root intent node. Optionally creates companion QVT assets.
MCP Tool: Relocates or renames an existing screen file on disk and updates all AgiArtifact, WorkspaceBuffer, and WorkEffort entity references in the database.
MCP Tool: Attaches a companion Vue/QVT component script to an existing XML screen, scaffolds the .qvt.js file, injects the script tag, and converts editor to AgiComponentEditor.
Injects a container layout widget into the active Meta-JSON AST in WorkspaceBuffer, persists the buffer, and re-compiles the clean XML back to disk.

parameter.name: containerType
parameter.description: Tag name: container, container-row, container-box, or section

parameter.name: containerId
parameter.description: Optional ID attribute for the new container

parameter.name: styleClass
parameter.description: Optional CSS class string (e.g. row items-center justify-between q-pa-sm)

parameter.name: parentContainerId
parameter.description: Target parent container ID or mariaId inside the screen AST

parameter.name: conditionScript
parameter.description: Optional Moqui Groovy condition for role/permission gating

service.description: Mounts child subscreens directly into the parent screen's Meta-JSON AST in WorkspaceBuffer, persists the buffer, and re-compiles the clean XML back to disk.
Retrieves the raw text content of an XML screen or companion QVT script asset on disk. Accepts either 'artifactUri' or 'screenPath' parameters.
Injects an action block (e.g. entity-find, service-call) into the screen's AST and persists the updated buffer to disk.
Restructures an active screen into a standard navigation hub layout: Creates a top Header Container with subscreens-tabs and a center Body Container with subscreens-active.
MCP Tool for AI Assistants to retrieve canonical, verified Moqui XML Screen archetypes (e.g., 'lookup-modal', 'form-crud', 'master-detail') adhering strictly to xml-screen-3.xsd standards.
Dynamically scans all active components for archetype templates located under /archetype// and returns structured descriptors.

actions.script:
import java.io.File import org.moqui.resource.ResourceReference
List results = [] List names = [] String searchType = archetypeType ?: "screen"
File compBase = new File("runtime/component") if (compBase.exists() && compBase.isDirectory()) { compBase.eachDir { File compDir -> String cName = compDir.name if (targetComponent && cName != targetComponent) return
File archetypeDir = new File(compDir, "archetype/${searchType}") if (archetypeDir.exists() && archetypeDir.isDirectory()) { archetypeDir.eachFile { File f -> if (f.isFile() && !f.name.startsWith(".") && (f.name.endsWith(".xml") || f.name.endsWith(".groovy"))) { String baseName = f.name.replaceAll('\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$', '') String uri = "component://${cName}/archetype/${searchType}/${f.name}"
names.add(baseName) results.add([ archetypeName : baseName, label : baseName, fileName : f.name, archetypeType : searchType, componentName : cName, locationUri : uri ]) } } } } }
context.archetypes = results context.archetypeNames = names.unique() ec.logger.info("📐 [get#ArchetypeCatalog] Discovered ${results.size()} dynamic archetypes for type '${searchType}'")
